final: WITH album_stats AS (SELECT AlbumId, COUNT(*) AS track_count, SUM(Bytes) AS total_bytes, SUM(Milliseconds) AS sized_milliseconds FROM Track WHERE Bytes IS NOT NULL GROUP BY AlbumId), album_rates AS (SELECT AlbumId, track_count, CAST(total_bytes AS REAL) / sized_milliseconds AS rate FROM album_stats WHERE sized_milliseconds > 0), mean_rate AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS value FROM album_rates) SELECT AVG(ar.rate) AS average_rate, AVG(ar.track_count) AS average_track_count, AVG(ar.rate - mr.value) AS average_amount_above_mean FROM album_rates AS ar CROSS JOIN mean_rate AS mr WHERE ar.rate > mr.value
